# Scratch check of the within-month figures quoted in decision.md (EUR, not cents).
OPEN, RES = 60_000, 10_000
def months(delay, principal=70_000, jan_inv=50_000):
    rec = {"base": {"02": jan_inv, "03": 50_000}, "delayed": {"03": jan_inv}}[delay]
    pay = {"01": 30_000, "02": 30_000 + principal, "03": 30_000}
    return [(m, pay[m], rec.get(m, 0)) for m in ("01", "02", "03")]
def run(ms, payments_first=True, extra=0):
    cash, low, out = OPEN + extra, OPEN + extra, []
    for m, p, r in ms:
        o = cash
        lo = cash - p if payments_first else cash + r - p if r >= 0 else None
        low = min(low, lo, cash - p + r)
        cash = cash - p + r
        out.append((m, o, p, o - p, r, cash))
    return out, low, max(0, RES - low)
for sc in ("base", "delayed"):
    me = run(months(sc), payments_first=False); ad = run(months(sc))
    print(sc, "month-end need", me[2], "timing-bound need", ad[2]); [print("  ", r) for r in ad[0]]
    print("  with month-end funding in place, timing low:", run(months(sc), extra=me[2])[1])
    print("  no principal: month-end", [r[5] for r in run(months(sc, principal=0))[0]], "need", run(months(sc, principal=0), payments_first=False)[2], "timing need", run(months(sc, principal=0))[2])
    print("  double jan invoice: month-end", [r[5] for r in run(months(sc, jan_inv=100_000))[0]], "need", run(months(sc, jan_inv=100_000), payments_first=False)[2], "timing need", run(months(sc, jan_inv=100_000))[2])
# Base, Jan invoice received before principal (costs may precede receipt); March adverse
cash = OPEN - 30_000; feb_low = min(cash - 30_000, cash - 30_000 + 50_000 - 70_000); cash = cash - 100_000 + 50_000
mar_low = cash - 30_000
print("base, Jan invoice before principal: Feb low", feb_low, "Mar adverse low", mar_low, "need", max(0, RES - min(feb_low, mar_low)), "need if Feb invoice also precedes March costs", max(0, RES - min(feb_low, cash)))
EOF
